ferryinn_host.text: Welcome to the Ferry Inn. Hot breakfast till eleven, hot opinions all day.
Holyhead is the gateway to Ireland. Ferries leave for Dublin Port, a little over three hours away.
We get walkers, lorry drivers and day-trippers on the same morning. All of them want the same egg.
Holy Island is joined to Anglesey by a long causeway, so technically you arrive by road and leave by sea.

ferryinn_guest.text: I am booked on the next boat. I have been booked on the next boat since breakfast.
The cliffs at South Stack are lovely, though. Watch for puffins in spring.

holyhead_ferryinn_shanty.text: Ferries leave from Holyhead for Ireland all day. Before engines, the songs on those decks were all that kept a crew pulling together. Care to join in? Pull when the line lights up.
